name: orc_whr_refprop_cost
title: Waste-heat-recovery ORC with a scroll expander, REFPROP mixtures and an equipment cost model
summary: Complete ORC recovering heat from an exhaust-gas/thermal-oil stream: three-zone plate evaporator and condenser with Thonon/Kuo/Hsieh correlations, scroll expander with fixed volume ratio, pump, pipe sizing and total equipment/investment cost; refrigerant properties as CoolProp calls on the mixture R245fa+R134a (the source uses the EES REFPROP interface; stored run: pure R245fa).

verification.reference: EES stored solution of the source file (386 variables), compared with the runnable _coolsolve variant: 356 common variables; eta_cycle agrees to 7.1e-4, W_dot_net to 5.0e-3, SIC to 1.3e-2; the pressure-drop correlations deviate up to 0.114 (transport-property differences REFPROP vs CoolProp, see README)
verification.notes: Maximum over all common variables 0.252 = absolute Air enthalpies h_a_ex_liq/h_a_ex_vap (reference-state offset EES ideal gas vs CoolProp Air; their temperatures agree). Excluding that pair, the maximum is 0.114 on the evaporator pressure-drop correlation DELTAp_ev. The 9 REFPROP pseudo-quality outputs (Q_r_* outside 0..1) are not reproduced; 21 EES-only variables are stale values of an older EES session; the 6 CoolSolve-only names are the string variables and pi. Native file not runnable (CS-GAP-END-PROCEDURE, CS-BUG-COMMON-PROC, CS-GAP-FLUIDS-MIXTURE). Frozen binary 2026-10-10: the variant's solution is not its committed .sol (older CoolProp build); SIC differs by a factor of about 1000 from the EES value (see README).
